evidence.quote: 百度通用版可启用试用密钥，每日最多查询 50 次

checkNote: Both quotes are in the README. The trial key (50 lookups a day) needs no user key of their own, while the Baidu dictionary edition and custom services need one. The README allows localhost HTTP services, but only as lookup/translation endpoints, not clearly AI, so local model stays unknown.
